basic_profile.bio: I'm a 21-year-old college student based in the Midwest, deeply passionate about education, motorbikes, and the latest in lifestyle trends. I spend my evenings researching college applications and exploring diverse hobbies, from maintaining my CRF250L dirt bike to keeping up with the latest in British news. As a business administration major, I balance my studies with part-time work at a local café. In my free time, I enjoy strategizing in mobile games and watching crime documentaries. Currently single, I often engage in online communities late at night when I unwind from a busy day.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a keen interest in higher education, I have self-taught much about college admissions through online forums and official university resources. My passion for motorbikes is fueled by hands-on experience and enthusiast communities, while my lifestyle insights are gleaned from personal exploration and online discussions.
